comments: Input facts: ego is the car responder; agent1 is the pedestrian initiator; one actor travels along the trafficway and the other crosses it without traveling along or onto another trafficway. Chosen assumptions: agent1 has paused just right of the lane center during a right-to-left crossing and initiates renewed movement when ego is within 17–20 m. Ego is the responder and commands a sustained zero speed when agent1 is within 9–12 m. Initial longitudinal separation is 22–28 m; pedestrian lateral offset is 0.4–0.8 m right of center; resumed walking speed is 1.2–1.6 m/s; ego target speed is 7–9 m/s. The pedestrian continues to a target 4–5 m left of lane center and never travels along another trafficway. No collision outcome is required. Adjacent lanes are not needed; the road fields do not forbid them.
